hunks.sol: But one woman standing a step ahead of the rest caught my eye at once.

hunks.sol: So Gyo. That was her name.

hunks.sol: Her voice was calm, and her eyes shone like the morning star. Even apart from her beautiful features, there was something unusual about her.

hunks.sol: “By His Majesty’s solemn command, we have been assigned to serve His Highness Prince Shangshan. We humble women will attend to you from now on, so please do not worry.”
